page_title: WER 2-0 AUG | Werder Bremen v Augsburg 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' A precise low pass is received by Nathanael Mbuku (Augsburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
90+3' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Here is a change. Marvin Ducksch is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Olivier Deman will be replaced by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen).

87' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Arne Engels (Augsburg) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Robert Gumny (Augsburg) coming on for Kevin Mbabu.
86' That's the end of the game for Fredrik Jensen, who is replaced by Nathanael Mbuku (Augsburg).
85' The attendance is 36000.

84' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
78' The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.
75' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) replaces Romano Schmid.
74' A corner kick by Augsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen).
72' It will be a substitution. Masaya Okugawa (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Vargas walks off.
71' Although Jess Thorup (Augsburg) is just on the bench, Sascha Stegemann has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

71' Wasted opportunity. Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
66' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Phillip Tietz is replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
66' Elvis Rexhbecaj will be replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
65' 2 - 0 Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fires the ball in and gets on the scoresheet!
64' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
58' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Leonardo Bittencourt as he is replaced by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).

57' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
55' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

53' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
53' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
52' The game is interrupted now, Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Augsburg are awarded a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings it in and Rafael Borre gets on the end of it, but Finn Dahmen shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
43' Dangerous play by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg). Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen in a dangerous position.
39' 1 - 0 Gooal! Marvin Ducksch takes over corner duties. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
38' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

38' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) got on the end of the corner and rifles a low shot from the edge of the box towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a stunning diving save. Werder Bremen get a corner.
38' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but it's cleared. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.

38' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
35' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
35' A pass by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
29' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
27' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
24' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

23' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
22' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
19' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
17' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
14' Werder Bremen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

13' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sascha Stegemann no option but to blow his whistle. Werder Bremen are awarded the free kick.
10' The resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) comes to nothing.
6' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.

5' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ruben Vargas, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
5' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Rough tackle by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
